items.claim: A typical weekday started quiet, reached its lowest point at 04:00 with 8.3%, then climbed through the morning to 30.9% at 11:00.
items.reason: The typical weekday trough is 8.3% at 04:00 and the peak is 30.9% at 11:00.

items.claim: After that it eased, while staying fairly active into the early evening.
items.reason: After the 11:00 peak, the fitted weekday profile is lower through the afternoon and remains in the mid-20s into early evening.

items.reason: Breiter Weg 203 has a significant adjusted increase of 17.9 points, with the raw mean rising from 25.6% to 44.6%.

items.claim: Another busy site was Hegelstraße 4, where no charging point was free for 23.4% of known time.
